title: Give retirement village inquiry and disclosure documents
what: Give a prospective resident a community arrangements statement, a prospective resident information statement and the other prescribed documents at least 10 working days before the residence contract.

sources.title: Retirement Villages Act 1992 (WA)
sources.quote: At least 10 working days before a person enters into a residence contract, the owner must cause to be given to that person — (a) a community arrangements statement; and (aa) a prospective resident information statement;

reach.condition: if it operates a retirement village
